triple: <http://example.org/dectective/profile#CommunicativeAct> <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment> "An act of telling or writing addressed to someone. Unlike crminf:I1 Argumentation (and E13, a subclass of I1 in CRMinf 1.2.1) it does NOT presuppose sincerity: the speaker's belief in the content is represented separately, if at all."
<http://example.org/dectective/profile#ExpectedToReturn> <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment> "Person whom the believer expects to come back (used only inside belief worlds)."
<http://example.org/dectective/profile#Impersonation> <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment> "Acting under a persona identified by an appellation that is not one's own."
<http://example.org/dectective/profile#establishes> <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment> "The actor's account accepted by the narrative as part of the reference reconstruction."

<http://example.org/dectective/profile#hasContent> <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment> "The proposition set communicated (encoded as a named graph). Communicating it does not imply belief."

<http://example.org/dectective/profile#hasDefectProfile> <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment> "Set of typing defects of a machine. Making it owl:InverseFunctionalProperty encodes Holmes's individuality principle (P116.S01-S02); that axiom is NOT shared: it lives only in the worlds that adopt it."
<http://example.org/dectective/profile#heldBy> <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment> "Local shortcut: holder of a belief (CRMinf links it only indirectly via I1/I7 P14 and J2)."
<http://example.org/dectective/profile#purportsToBeFrom> <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment> "Apparent sender as shown on the document; not authorship."
<http://example.org/dectective/profile#reportedBy> <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment> "Who reports the act in the text (e.g. Mary reporting Hosmer's words)."
<http://example.org/dectective/profile#uttered> <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment> "Verbatim content of a communicative act; no commitment of the speaker implied."
